authorRole.en: Publisher of free time card, overtime and pay-period calculators built on U.S. federal and state wage-hour rules

authorDesc.en: Radif Partners writes the arithmetic behind every punch on this site from the texts a payroll clerk would open: the Fair Labor Standards Act and its hours-worked rules in 29 CFR Part 785, California Labor Code section 510, the Alaska Wage and Hour Act, Colorado's COMPS Order #40 and the Department of Labor's state table for Nevada. Each rule carries the date it was last read, and the calculators run in your browser without an account.

description: Weekly time card with breaks, quarter-hour rounding and overtime by state (FLSA, California, Alaska, Nevada, Colorado), plus 2026 pay periods and work days.
